user.title: Kohler Konnect
user.description: Choose how to sign in. OAuth is recommended; the legacy password flow is provided as a fallback for existing accounts.

oauth.title: Sign in with Kohler
oauth.description:
1. Open this URL in a browser and sign in to your Kohler account:

{authorize_url}

2. After signing in, the browser will try to open `msauth://...` and fail. That is expected.

3. From the URL bar of the failed page, copy the value of the `code=` query parameter and paste it below.

ropc.title: Kohler Konnect (legacy)
ropc.description: Enter your Kohler Konnect account credentials. Note: this method may stop working in the future; prefer OAuth where possible.

reauth_ropc.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_ropc.description: Your stored credentials are no longer valid. Re-enter your password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check credentials and try again.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account.
error.invalid_code: The authorization code could not be exchanged. Make sure you copied the full `code` value and try again.
error.no_refresh_token: Sign-in succeeded but no refresh token was issued. Check the integration logs.
